top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling to Buchwald and Hartwig is the only proposal with clean attribution, no maturity question after about thirty years of independent confirmation and industrial use, and a ligand-controlled catalytic solution (C-N reductive elimination versus beta-hydride elimination) not covered by the 2010 C-C coupling prize. P003 adds a Liu-only base-editing part whose attribution (Komor, Gaudelli, Kondo, Nishida) is unresolved, so it ranks below the clean stand-alone prize; P001 follows because the structural evidence for ternary complexes is strong, though the glue strand and approved-drug record remain open.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; only a Stockholm University colleague tie to Secretary Peter Brzezinski, which does not bear on any candidacy in the slate
